attchmntText: Arihant Capital Markets Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 18, 2026.
voiceSummary: Arihant Capital Markets Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 18, 2026. The Board approved the proposal to sponsor and set up a Mutual Fund, following in-principle approval from SEBI. This includes the proposed business structure and implementation framework. The Board also approved the incorporation of subsidiary companies required for the Mutual Fund business. This involves establishing an Asset Management Company and a Trustee Company. These actions are subject to applicable laws and requisite regulatory approvals. The Board authorized Directors and Key Managerial Personnel to execute documents and make filings with SEBI and stock exchanges. The meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 05:10 P.M.
